quote: As part of the investigation, warranty data was analyzed and five warranty claims potentially related to this issue were identified, all on MY2021 Prevost X3-45 Commuter.
reason: An analysis (warranty data analyzed) conducted to find the scope of the issue is INVESTIGATION_START per rules ('analysis or testing is ... conducted to find the cause or scope').

quote: 2023-02-27 Prevost requested the seat supplier to perform a survey on potentially affected vehicles to support the ongoing investigation.
reason: Requesting a field survey of potentially affected vehicles starts an investigative activity to find scope; INVESTIGATION_START fits better than OTHER.

quote: According to the supplier, approximately 63% of the inspected vehicles had at least one loose or disengaged seat recline mechanism bolt.
reason: The supplier reports a finding about the problem to the filer, which is SUPPLIER_NOTICE ('the supplier confirmed ...', 'a finding').

quote: The field report indicated that the seat recline function was inoperative and that the seatback could move freely on certain seats.
reason: This sentence only describes the content of the field report already counted in the preceding sentence; it reports no new action, so it is not an event.
The sentence has its own dates, so it yields events with those dates (FILER_AWARENESS), not an inherited 2023-01-27 OTHER event.
Distinct own date in the sentence; warranty claims reaching the filer are FILER_AWARENESS.
Distinct own date in the sentence; warranty claim receipt is FILER_AWARENESS.
Distinct own date (2022-12-21, listed twice, one event); warranty claim receipt is FILER_AWARENESS.
2023-02-14 is a distinct own date in the sentence; warranty claim receipt is FILER_AWARENESS, so the event exists.

quote: 2023-08-17: Added Prevost's identification code for this recall.
reason: Amending the Part 573 report (adding the recall ID code) is NHTSA_FILING ('submits or amends a Part 573 report').

quote: 2023-06-05: 2 additional power steering hose failures are reported from the same customer. A field report is created.
reason: The versions are two different sentences of the same entry, both valid events: the dated customer report (FILER_AWARENESS) and the inherited 'A field report is created' (OTHER). The pairing, not the type, differs; rules do not settle which one this item refers to.

quote: January 18 - 22, 2023 Cummins had indication that there had been fuel line failures out in the field these where brought to their attention during the Tampa RV Super show.
reason: This sentence is the supplier (Cummins) becoming aware, not the filer, so X's FILER_AWARENESS is wrong; it is OTHER. Y's inherited event (Pleasure-Way removed generators, inside the same dated entry) is a valid OTHER event with that date.

quote: Cummins conducted a review and testing of the product and concluded on March 28, 2023 that a defect existed.
reason: A conclusion that a defect exists is DECISION ('the decision that a safety defect or noncompliance exists'); the rule does not limit DECISION to the filer.

quote: April 21, 2023 Pleasure-Way provided a list to Cummins  of all owners and dealers with the generators under recall.
reason: Providing owner/dealer lists for the recall is remedy logistics (owner/dealer notification), which the rules exclude from events.
